findings.summary: The weekly open/closed editing state machine was undefined.
findings.requiredCorrection: Specify accessible switch semantics, null serialization, draft-only time restoration, persisted-null reopen behavior, and no invented defaults.

findings.summary: Paper order, direction-sensitive sequences, heading/inset ownership, weekly typography, invalid-state behavior, and four-frame comparison were underspecified or contradictory.
The lower action frontier must be mobile/stacked only and runtime Arabic copy needs a native expansion review.
